policy: P6 warm symmetry: 2 send(s) at concurrency 2 over 2 warm rows, the same on both arms (--warm-sends/--warm-concurrency)

response_pid_distribution.note: REPORTED, NOT GATED (Crossroad 41). uvicorn workers are selected by the kernel at accept and /process_video does not block its event loop, so response-pid spread measures scheduling, not warmth. Warmth is gated on the service warm markers.

note: pid identity is only comparable within ONE container lifetime (defect #23: pid reuse across restarts)
